description: We are Team KAMBS, computer science students who turn real problems into working products. We bring full stack web and mobile development, testing and AI/ML skills. At NASA Space Apps 2025, we built a working web project in 3 days, won 3rd place regionally and became a global nominee. This year we’re aiming for first. Join us for a proven record, a clear plan and real work. We need: a UI/UX designer, a data/ML person (NASA or Earth observation data), a researcher and a strong presenter.
